officialSources.description: LEGO lists set 7699 (2007), MT-101 Armored Drilling Unit, with both official instruction books.
Book 1 establishes the two-wheel mini-bike and the completed rear spacecraft as distinct nested source models.
The cover is the complete-configuration appearance anchor. Page 35 documents the main chassis only; pages 42–43 document the rear-module/bike relationship and assembly context.

derivedTarget.description: Unchanged source-led T082 accepted appearance raster, reused as the clear completed-model target showing the attached rear aircraft module. Official LEGO book 2 cover remains the overall appearance anchor.

interpretation.targetPolicy: The official book 2 cover is the full-set authority; reuse the already director-accepted source-led T082 completed-appearance raster as the clear Production Design Target because independent photos and instruction page 35 commonly omit the attached rear aircraft module.
interpretation.bikeRelation: Book 2 pages 42–43 and book 1 pages 8 and 29 establish the nested mini-bike inside the directly docked rear spacecraft/aircraft module. The bike is not an additional runtime roster entry.
interpretation.sourceCaveat: Independent assembled-set photos located in research commonly show only the main drilling chassis. The official book 2 cover establishes the full attached-module configuration; the T082 accepted source-led appearance raster communicates it clearly.

provenanceNote: The page rasters above are preserved, unmodified T082 reference files. Their SHA-256 values are cross-checked against the T082 source-rebuild and nested-appearance manifests; official LEGO PDFs remain the primary source links. The review target is not a generated reconstruction.
